newsitem.title: UK: UK stocks end higher but doubts remain about rally.
newsitem.headline: UK stocks end higher but doubts remain about rally.

text.p: UK shares finished mostly higher on Tuesday, underpinned by Wall Street's resilience as well as a firm gilts market.
Equity prices ended within striking distance all-time highs but new records may not be seen until after the FTSE has suffered a small downward correction, dealers and analysts said.
"The market seems to get a collective nosebleed whenever it tests the highs," one senior trader said.
"I've no doubt we'll crack through 4,100 (level) but the FTSE will need to go down before that happens."
The FTSE 100 closed 24.1 points higher at 4,035.7.
